name: clear-message-rewriter
title: Clear message rewriter
summary: Rewrites an email, announcement or set of instructions so it is clear, direct and easy to act on.
what_it_does: A paragraph in plain English explaining what the skill does and who it helps.
how_it_works: You paste in your draft and, if you like, say who it's for.
It puts the purpose in the first line and numbers each thing you're asking for.
It gives you the rewrite, then a short list of what it changed and why.
good_for: Emails asking colleagues to do something by a date
not_for: Formal letters that must follow a fixed template
try_saying: Can you make this email clearer?
Rewrite this announcement so students know exactly what to do.
